```{r}
library(TCGAbiolinks)

query_luad <- GDCquery(
  project = "TCGA-LUAD",
  data.category = "DNA Methylation",
  data.type = "Methylation Beta Value",
  platform = "Illumina Human Methylation 450",
  sample.type = "Primary Tumor"
)

# Number of files found
nrow(getResults(query_luad))
```

```{r}

)
```

```{r}
patient_ids <- substr(colnames(betas), 1, 12)

match_index <- match(
  patient_ids,
  luad_clinical$bcr_patient_barcode
)

# Check matched and unmatched samples
table(matched = !is.na(match_index))

# Align clinical rows with the methylation columns
clinical_matched <- luad_clinical[match_index, , drop = FALSE]

# Check N stages in the matched data
table(clinical_matched$ajcc_pathologic_n, useNA = "ifany")

# Check for repeated patients among methylation samples
sum(duplicated(patient_ids))

#the result is the 473 methylation samples, with N stages matched from the clinical data
```
```{r}
repeated <- duplicated(patient_ids) |
  duplicated(patient_ids, fromLast = TRUE)

data.frame(
  sample = colnames(betas)[repeated],
  patient = patient_ids[repeated],
  N_stage = clinical_matched$ajcc_pathologic_n[repeated]
)
# some patients have multiple methylation samples
```
```{r}
# Sort sample IDs, then keep one sample per patient
sample_order <- order(colnames(betas))

keep_index <- sample_order[
  !duplicated(patient_ids[sample_order])
]

# Subset both objects in the same order
betas_unique <- betas[, keep_index, drop = FALSE]
clinical_unique <- clinical_matched[keep_index, , drop = FALSE]

# Check sample count and N stages
ncol(betas_unique)
table(clinical_unique$ajcc_pathologic_n, useNA = "ifany")
```
```{r}
stage <- as.character(clinical_unique$ajcc_pathologic_n)

keep <- stage %in% c("N0", "N1", "N2", "N3")

clinical_n <- clinical_unique[keep, , drop = FALSE]
betas_n <- betas_unique[, keep, drop = FALSE]

# Combine N1, N2, and N3 into N+
clinical_n$group <- factor(
  ifelse(stage[keep] == "N0", "N0", "Nplus"),
  levels = c("N0", "Nplus")
)

table(clinical_n$group)
dim(betas_n)
```
```{r}
# Keep sites with valid beta values in every sample
valid_cpg <- rowSums(
  !is.finite(betas_n) | betas_n < 0 | betas_n > 1
) == 0

betas_clean <- betas_n[valid_cpg, , drop = FALSE]

# Check how many CpGs were kept or removed
table(valid_cpg)
dim(betas_clean)
```
```{r}
library(limma)

# Avoid infinite M-values at beta = 0 or 1
betas_clipped <- pmin(pmax(betas_clean, 1e-6), 1 - 1e-6)

mval <- log2(betas_clipped / (1 - betas_clipped))

# N0 is the reference group
design <- model.matrix(~ group, data = clinical_n)

fit <- lmFit(mval, design)
fit2 <- eBayes(fit)

# Check the model coefficients
colnames(fit2$coefficients)

```
```{r}
# Mean beta-value difference: N+ minus N0
delta_beta <-
  rowMeans(betas_clean[, clinical_n$group == "Nplus", drop = FALSE]) -
  rowMeans(betas_clean[, clinical_n$group == "N0", drop = FALSE])

dat <- data.frame(
  CpG = rownames(betas_clean),
  delta_beta = delta_beta,
  pvalue = fit2$p.value[, "groupNplus"]
)

# Adjust for testing many CpG sites
dat$FDR <- p.adjust(dat$pvalue, method = "BH")

# Inspect the most statistically significant results
head(dat[order(dat$FDR), ])
```
```{r}
library(ggplot2)

dat$status <- "FDR >= 0.05"
dat$status[which(dat$FDR < 0.05 & dat$delta_beta > 0)] <-
  "Higher in N+"
dat$status[which(dat$FDR < 0.05 & dat$delta_beta < 0)] <-
  "Lower in N+"

p <- ggplot(
  dat,
  aes(
    x = delta_beta,
    y = -log10(pmax(FDR, .Machine$double.xmin)),
    color = status
  )
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "FDR >= 0.05" = "grey75",
    "Higher in N+" = "#D55E00",
    "Lower in N+" = "#0072B2"
  )) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = -log10(0.05),
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = c(-0.10, 0.10),
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "LUAD: N+ versus N0",
    x = "Mean methylation difference (N+ minus N0)",
    y = "-log10(FDR)",
    color = NULL
  ) +
  theme_bw()

print(p)
```
